annual_discount_text: Core: a 25% savings with annual billing; Advanced: a 6% savings with annual billing
notes: Only one page view was provided (as it loads). Prices are per license and listed as starting prices; the page says they are estimates that may exclude VAT/GST and promotional discounts. USD prices recorded; the FAQ also lists AUD, CAD, EUR and GBP prices for Core and Advanced (not recorded): Core A$154.99/month or A$1,499.88/year, C$144.99/month or C$1,199.88/year, EUR 120.99/month or EUR 1,088.88/year, G£94.99/month or £959.88/year; Advanced A$189.99/month or A$2,159.88/year, C$179.99/month or C$2,039.88/year, EUR 148.21/month or EUR 1,693.88/year, £130.00/month or £1,499.88/year. Advanced Plus pricing is customized by team size, CRM integration and onboarding needs; request demo for a quote. Free trials are offered for Core and Advanced. Advanced allows up to five licenses online; more via admin. Team seat management and centralized billing is a feature of the team plans, but no seat count is stated.
